LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidChance: Strike team chance per enemy caravan: {0}
LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidChance_Desc: While your colony is neutral with XCC, each trade caravan from a faction hostile to XCC has this chance of drawing an XCC strike team. 0% turns it off.
LanguageData.WBE_AidPlunder: Unharmed XCC squads plunder when leaving
LanguageData.WBE_AidPlunder_Desc: An XCC squad called in with favor or requested on the comms console that leaves without taking any damage carries off the most valuable loads within a wide radius, stockpiles included, on the way out. They know their way around and open your doors.
LanguageData.WBE_BestowingPenalty: Goodwill lost when an XCC bestowing ceremony fails: {0}
LanguageData.WBE_BestowingPenalty_Desc: XCC blames you for any failed bestowing ceremony, whatever went wrong. The loss never takes goodwill low enough to turn XCC hostile. 0 turns it off.
LanguageData.WBE_DriftPlunder: XCC loots instead of drifting goodwill down
LanguageData.WBE_DriftPlunder_Desc: Every 50 days vanilla drifts XCC's goodwill 10 towards its natural level. If XCC is neutral with you, goodwill is below 0 and your colony is rich enough, XCC sends a squad to loot instead (they open your doors). What they carry off buys goodwill back as a vanilla gift would (40 silver = 1 while goodwill is at or below 0, less the friendlier XCC is). The squad takes no more than it needs to reach 80 (75 is an alliance). If they take nothing, the vanilla drift applies.
LanguageData.WBE_DriftPlunderMinWealth: Minimum colony wealth for XCC looters: {0}
LanguageData.WBE_DriftPlunderMinWealth_Desc: Checked on your richest home map. Below it, the vanilla drift applies. The default 14000 is where vanilla wealth starts adding raid points.
LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidArrived: An {XCC_name} strike team has followed the {CARAVAN_name} caravan here and is moving in to attack it.
LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidPlunder: The {FACTION_name} strike team is looting before it leaves.
LanguageData.WBE_DriftPlunderArrived: {FACTION_name} has sent a squad to "keep relations good". It is about to loot your colony.
LanguageData.WBE_AidPlunderMessage: The {FACTION_name} squad left unscratched and feels you wasted its time. It is looting on the way out as compensation.
